text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Demon Legs Нарита Таисин does it!
Нарита Таисин
takes first place!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaahhh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Taishin! Taishin! Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The crowd is going wild, but I can hear
her yelling
for me over the noise.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I jump the fence and go straight to her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer... I get it. I understand now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I don't race because it's all I have or
because I
don't have any other choice...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I do it because this is what I want. I want to race!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And I want to win my races!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Basking in the cheers of the audience,
Narita
Taishin and I are overjoyed in our
newfound
resolve to keep pushing
forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, I wanna talk to you about my next
goal.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I wanna run in the spring Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Hayahide said they're going
for it too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I was nowhere near their level when we
ran in the
Kikuka Sho. So...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: This is your chance to redeem yourself, then!

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you're seriously so cringe when you
get
hyper-enthused like that, but...
yeah.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Anyway...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I want you to help me prepare for it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
With our sights set anew, Нарита Таисин
and I
prepare for the spring Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
